pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

morph.tooltip: Morph (soemdsp Ellipsoid::getSineToSquare). 0 = sine, 1 = square. Limit AA always on (edge floor by f/sr).

motion.tooltip: Ph = running phasor (CounterClock(Ph) is the original orbit). T = simulation time (sample count / sample rate), no stored phasor. Clock vs CounterClock flips direction.

amplitude.tooltip: Output scale. Domain min/max are slider guides only (type large values for absolute-Hz CV).

mix.tooltip: Dry/wet balance on the Mix outputs (not a wet-only path).

seed.tooltip: Randomizes the delay line pattern. Same seed always reproduces the same reverb character.

recycle.tooltip: Feedback amount for the reverb tail.

gainDb.tooltip: Master gain (−∞…+12 dB) applied to Mono/Left/Right. 0 dB is unity. Old patches that stored linear Amplitude are converted on load.

leftDb.tooltip: Extra gain on the Left path (−∞…+12 dB). 0 dB is unity.

offset.tooltip: DC offset after scale (same as former Gain Bias).

monoSum.tooltip: How Left and Right become Mono Out. Average = (L+R)/2 (unity for dual-mono). Power = RMS with mid sign. Sum = L+R. Equal-power = (L+R)/√2. Peak = larger-magnitude channel. Left / Right = that channel only.

rightDb.tooltip: Extra gain on the Right path (−∞…+12 dB). 0 dB is unity.

attack.tooltip: How fast gain reduces when over ceiling (0 = instant).

ceiling.tooltip: Brickwall ceiling in dBFS. Peaks are held to this level (after look-ahead gain).

dipGain.tooltip: Over-reduction after the exact brickwall cut. 1× = just enough for the Ceiling. 2× = twice the dB of dip. Slider min/max are yours in Parameter Settings — DSP does not clamp this. Hidden by default.

release.tooltip: How fast gain returns to unity after a peak (slow enough not to pump bass).

lookaheadMs.tooltip: Look-ahead delay in milliseconds (modulatable). Audio is delayed by this amount so gain can fall before peaks — not host-compensated. 0 = instantaneous limiting.

gainCompensation.tooltip: On = apply makeup of −Ceiling after the brickwall so limited peaks sit at 0 dBFS. Off = output stays at the Ceiling. Gain jack still reports the reduction.

lookaheadEnabled.tooltip: On = delay audio by Look-ahead so gain can fall before peaks. Off = instantaneous limiting (no delay).

lookaheadSamples.tooltip: Extra look-ahead in samples (added to Look-ahead ms). Same idea as Sample Delay samples.
